_note: The agent's voice. Eunbi-editable: change sentences freely, keep {placeholders} as-is. Server picks a different variant from last time. persona is the one place for the shown/spoken name, wake phrase and TTS voice (server prompt + app).

live.fallback_line: Live off — one command at a time
live._keywords: Lab words the live transcriber should expect (cell lines, reagents, assays), besides the protocol's own.

session_thanks: Anytime! Call me whenever you need me.
Happy to help. I'm here when you need me.
timer_done: Heads up! {minutes} minutes are up on {wells_spoken}.
catch_off_plan: Wait — {wells_spoken} isn't in this step. Still log it?
Hmm, {wells_spoken} isn't planned here. Log it anyway?
not_found_timer: Hmm, I don't see a {label} timer. Want me to start one?
invalid_well: {target} isn't on the plate. Which well did you mean?
Hmm, {target} isn't a valid well. Which one?
cant_do_physical: I can't hand things over, but I can log it or set a timer.
Hands are yours — I can log it or set a timer though.
didnt_act: I didn't log anything — want me to?
Hmm, I didn't record that — should I?
Nothing logged yet — want me to log it?
confirm_plan: The plan calls for {minutes} minutes on {wells_spoken}. Start it?
already_saved: {name} is already in your library. Say start a run.
end_run: Finish up and close this run?
import_known: Already saved as {name}. Open it or review again?
review_resumed: You started reviewing this. Picking up at step {step}.
review_unavailable: I can't open the review for {name}: {reason}.
save_as: {name} already exists. Save as version {version}, or keep as a separate protocol?
didnt_act_target: I didn't log {target} — want me to?
Hmm, nothing logged on {target} — should I log it?

cards._note: What a card shows: title (big line) and detail (small line) per card kind; {question} / {detail} are the spoken question and the old detail. Slots: wells, group, reason, note, step, done, minutes, label. An empty slot drops its ' · ' part.

confirm_photo.title: Send a photo?
confirm_photo.detail: Only the part you ask about leaves the iPad

unmarked.title: {wells} not marked
unmarked.detail: Mark all {n} done and go to step {step}?

save_as.title: {name} already exists
save_as.detail: Save as version {version}, or keep it separate?

prompts._note: Milo's line at the top of each screen (registry screen `prompt` -> key here), spoken on entry. The first template whose {slots} all have values is used; slots come from the server (store.view_slots), never example values.
home: Import a protocol, or pick a run.
import_photo: {pages} so far. Say one more, or done.
Snap the pages. Say take it.
import_file: No files yet. In the Files app, put PDFs in On My iPad, {app}.

unmarked_step: {wells} not marked. Mark all {n} done and go to step {step}?
all_steps_done: All steps done. Finish the run?
new_run: {run} is finished. Start a new run of {name}?
look_none: I can't find a {target}. Try again closer.
look_unread: I couldn't read it. Try again closer.
look_hint: Look at it and say take it
look_no_photo: I couldn't get the photo from the glasses. Try again.
look_send_failed: I couldn't check the photo. Try again.
confirm_photo: Send a photo to answer that?
search_slow: That took too long. Try again?
search_no_source: I couldn't find a solid source.
search_private: I'd have to send your lab details. Ask it without them?
